content.text:
Done. The iframe now auto-sizes to its content:

- [docs/scripts/canvas-rce-iframe-height.ts](docs/scripts/canvas-rce-iframe-height.ts) — new module that measures the document's content height and posts `{ type: "pantoken:canvas-rce:height", height }` to the parent on load, on `resize`, and via a `ResizeObserver` on `documentElement` (deduped so identical heights don't re-post). It only runs when framed.
- [docs/scripts/build-canvas-rce.ts](docs/scripts/build-canvas-rce.ts) — copies that module into the rendered project and injects a `<script type="module">` tag into `index.html` before the Vite build, so the published `canvas-theme-editor` starter template stays free of embedding code.
- [docs/.vitepress/theme/canvas-rce.ts](docs/.vitepress/theme/canvas-rce.ts) — exports `CANVAS_RCE_HEIGHT_MESSAGE` as the shared message type.
- [docs/.vitepress/theme/components/CanvasRcePage.vue](docs/.vitepress/theme/components/CanvasRcePage.vue) — listens for `message`, validates `event.origin === window.location.origin` and `event.source === iframe.contentWindow`, then applies the reported height inline. Added `scrolling="no"`; the CSS viewport height remains as the pre-report fallback.

One thing to flag: I couldn't run the bundle build to completion — `node scripts/build-canvas-rce.ts` fails on your in-progress template edit importing `@pantoken/css/style.rebrand.css`, which isn't in that package's `exports` (only `style.rebrand.light.css` is). That failure is unrelated to this change; the injection step itself is verified in the render dir.

content.text:
Fixed and verified in the browser at `/guide/canvas-rce` — the frame now sizes to its content (1028px), has no internal scrollbar, and the docs page scrolls.

Two real bugs caused the earlier no-op:

1. **The reporter was being bundled into the app chunk.** Vite merged the extra entry into `index-*.js`, and the app throws a `TypeError` during init (pre-existing, `addEventListener` on null) which aborted the rest of the chunk before the reporter ever ran. It's now [docs/scripts/canvas-rce-iframe-height.js](docs/scripts/canvas-rce-iframe-height.js), copied into the render project's `public/` and referenced as a plain `<script>` so it's served verbatim and runs independently of the app.
2. **`requestAnimationFrame` never fires in that framed document**, so the coalescing callback (and therefore every report) was dropped. Replaced with a 50ms `setTimeout` debounce.

Reporting now triggers on initial run, `load`, `resize`, a `ResizeObserver` on `documentElement`, and a `MutationObserver` on the subtree — verified growing (1028 → 1328 after injecting content) and shrinking back, and recomputing across viewport resizes.

[docs/scripts/build-canvas-rce.ts](docs/scripts/build-canvas-rce.ts) copies the script into `public/` and injects the tag; [CanvasRcePage.vue](docs/.vitepress/theme/components/CanvasRcePage.vue) applies the reported height inline (origin- and source-checked). Bundle rebuilt.

Unrelated things I noticed but left alone: the iframe app's `TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'addEventListener')` at startup, and a stray `docs/--port/` directory that's producing lint errors in `vp check`.
